subject.title: [Bug]: Compaction fails with 'Thread group size (1024) exceeds maximum threads per threadgroup (896)'

question: Should failed overflow compaction for local OpenAI-compatible providers keep manual reset/new recovery, add marker-first observability, or add a stronger provider-agnostic degraded recovery path?
rationale: Current source and docs intentionally block with manual recovery after exhausted compaction, while changing that behavior affects replay safety, session continuity, provider routing, and whether new config surface is acceptable.

options.title: Design provider-agnostic recovery
options.body: Add a safe degraded recovery or operator-visible recovery flow for compaction-provider failures without starting with an MLX-specific thread knob.

options.title: Accept marker-first observability
options.body: Treat the related marker PR as the first supported step and keep manual reset/new recovery in place for now.

options.title: Add MLX request tuning
options.body: Add a narrow configuration path only after confirming the MLX server accepts a stable request-body field that existing extra_body cannot express.

recommendation.title: Design provider-agnostic recovery
recommendation.body: Add a safe degraded recovery or operator-visible recovery flow for compaction-provider failures without starting with an MLX-specific thread knob.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is centered on compaction and context-engine recovery semantics, which CONTRIBUTING.md routes to this owner area.
